verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec titled "Programmatically control Airbyte Cloud, OSS & Enterprise." It also ships a Terraform provider for configuration as code, and API breaking changes come with migration guides. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. UI-centric features such as the no-code Connector Builder and its AI Assistant, notification setup, and the Connection Timeline have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or endpoint coverage map, API access to Connector Builder, notifications and timeline/log features, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
